description: Canonical registry for runtime, data, product and ML quality metrics that exist in this repository.

status_definitions.declared: The stable definition is approved but no repository implementation claims to emit it yet.
status_definitions.implemented: The metric is emitted from the registered source and covered by tests.
status_definitions.deprecated: The metric remains during a documented compatibility window and names its replacement.

metrics.name: stock_assistant_attention_risk_index
metrics.description: Current zero-to-one-hundred information verification pressure for the fixed R1 instrument; absent values are not emitted as zero.

metrics.name: stock_assistant_behavior_pressure_research
metrics.description: Current zero-to-one-hundred research-only market-structure pressure score; it is not a probability or trading recommendation.

metrics.name: stock_assistant_product_company_quality_score_v3
metrics.description: Current report score, 0-100, not a probability or recommendation. Grade 0-4 times 25; weights business .20, financial .20, competitive .15, management .10, valuation .15, risk resilience .20. Real evidence uses existing reliability adjustment; synthetic_scenario uses coefficient 1 and evidence_confidence 0. Any missing dimension leaves overall absent, without neutral filler or weight redistribution. Real and synthetic populations must never be pooled; historical scores are not recomputed. Consumer: report/reader and private Web; no monitoring exporter or alert added.
